jobs.description: CMS Construction Management Solutions Oy is looking for an experienced Site Manager for a industrial project in the Gothenburg region, Sweden.As Site Manager, you will be responsible for coordinating and overseeing daily site activities, contractors and multidisciplinary works. The project is approaching the pre-commissioning and commissioning phase, and an important part of the role is to support a controlled transition from construction and mechanical completion towards commissioning.**Your responsibilities include**- managing and coordinating daily construction and site activities - coordinating contractors, technical disciplines and other site stakeholders - monitoring site progress, resources and upcoming activities - ensuring that works are carried out according to project requirements, schedule, quality standards and safety procedures - identifying and resolving constraints, interface issues and other matters affecting site progress - coordinating the transition from construction and mechanical completion towards pre-commissioning and commissioning - supporting system handovers, inspections, testing and commissioning preparations - monitoring safety, quality, schedule and cost performance - reporting site progress and key issues to project management **We are looking for**- relevant technical education - extensive experience in similar Site Manager, Construction Manager or site management roles in industrial projects - strong understanding of construction site operations and multidisciplinary coordination - good understanding of safety, quality and schedule requirements in industrial projects - good IT and reporting skills - good command of English **Applicants must have the right to work in Sweden.****Accommodation and project-related travel can be arranged by CMS as agreed.****Location:** Gothenburg region, Sweden **Start:** December 2026 – January 2027 **Estimated duration:** approximately 6 months

jobs.occupation: Mechanical Engineer  From CAD Clean-up to Next-Generation Boat Design
jobs.description: Mechanical Engineer“Make X Shore’s CAD data something production can build from without guessing. Audit and rebuild assemblies, align them with the factory floor, and then help design the next-generation boat.”About the RoleX Shore’s existing CAD models and assemblies don’t fully reflect what’s actually being built on the factory floor — data has drifted from production reality, making it hard to trust drawings, plan rework, or hand off clean information to manufacturing. We’re looking for a Mechanical Engineer to audit and rebuild that CAD data, get it aligned with how boats are actually produced, and then move on to design work on X Shore’s next-generation boat platform.This is a hands-on role in two phases. First, you’ll dig into existing CAD, correct what’s out of sync with production, and work closely with the shop floor to close the gap between design intent and built reality. Once that foundation is solid, you’ll shift into forward-looking platform design for future boats. You’ll report to the Mechanical Engineering & Analysis Manager and be based on-site in Nyköping.Key Responsibilities    Audit existing CAD models and assemblies for accuracy, completeness, and structure    Rebuild or correct CAD data that no longer reflects what’s actually being built in production    Align CAD assemblies and drawings with current production reality, working directly with the shop floor    Identify and resolve discrepancies between design intent and manufactured parts    Maintain clean, well-structured CAD/PDM practices going forward    Support production with drawings, tolerances, and design clarifications during rework and manufacturing    Once alignment work is complete, contribute to the design and detailing of X Shore’s next-generation boat platform    Collaborate with electrical, production, and manufacturing engineering teams to ensure designs are manufacturableRequired Qualifications    Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent practical experience    3-5+ years of experience in mechanical design, ideally in a manufacturing environment    Expert-level SOLIDWORKS proficiency — this is a must-have, including assemblies, drawings, and PDM    Demonstrated experience auditing, cleaning up, or rebuilding CAD data and assemblies    Comfortable working directly with production to resolve build discrepancies    Fluent in English; Swedish is a plus    Ability to work on-site in NyköpingDesirable Qualifications    Experience with composites and/or metals typical of marine or automotive manufacturing    Background in boat building, automotive, or another complex hardware environment    Familiarity with GD&T and tolerance stack-up analysis    Experience contributing to a new product platform from early concept through releasePersonal QualitiesDetail-oriented and methodical, comfortable untangling messy legacy data without losing momentum. Equally at home on the shop floor verifying fit as at a CAD workstation. Takes ownership, follows through, and communicates clearly across engineering and production.Success Metrics (First 12 Months)    CAD data and assemblies for existing boats are audited, corrected, and aligned with what’s built in production    Production has accurate, trustworthy drawings and models to work from    Discrepancies between design and manufactured parts are identified and resolved    Meaningful contribution made to next-generation boat platform designLocation & StructureOn-site at X Shore Factory & HQ, Nyköping. Reports to the Mechanical Engineering & Analysis Manager.

jobs.occupation: Senior Product Manager - Stockholm or Hudiksvall
jobs.description: Want to tackle complex customer problems, shape product strategy, and turn insight into measurable impact? Come and join us as a Senior Product Manager.About the RoleWe’re looking for a Senior Product Manager who combines strategic thinking with hands-on product leadership. You’ll shape the vision and strategy for your product area and turn customer insights into measurable customer and business outcomes. You’ll lead your Product Trio and the work of your empowered cross-functional team through expertise, influence, and collaboration, without formal people-management responsibilities.What You’ll DoProduct Leadership    Set the vision and strategy for your product area.    Lead discovery and delivery with your Product Trio and cross functional team.    Use customer insights and data to define impactful solutions.    Set success metrics and ensure measurable outcomes.    Align stakeholders across commercial, technical, and customer-facing teams.    Lead through influence and champion modern product practices.You’ll often lead your team remotely rather than work together in person day to day, making strong communication and trust-building essential.Who You AreTo succeed in this role, you bring strategic thinking, strong collaboration skills, and a natural drive to move things forward. We place more weight on your personal qualities than on having the “perfect” resume.You are:    A strong collaborator who builds trust and brings people together.    Confident in making decisions, even in complex situations.    Proactive and self‑driven, with a strong sense of ownership.    Strategic, analytical, and able to prioritise what matters most.    Goal- and results-oriented with the energy to drive progress.    A supportive, inclusive leader who develops and coaches others.    Guided by integrity and empathy, fostering a positive and safe environment.What You BringWe believe the right mindset and personal qualities matter most. But to thrive, you likely have:    Experience as a Product Manager working with modern product development.    Curiosity and drive. You make things happen rather than wait for direction.    Strong communication skills in English; Swedish is an advantage.    Experience with SaaS, the Product Operating Model, or Agile frameworks is a plus.    Experience working with AI coding assistants and context repositories is a plus.Who We AreWe are Bjorn Lunden, the business platform that simplifies everyday life for small and medium-sized businesses. Our belief is simple: every business deserves opportunities to grow, and we’re here to make that happen 🐻.We’re on an exciting journey. With bold ambitions, our vision is to become one of the leading providers of accounting and financial software solutions in Northwestern Europe. With our roots in Hälsingland, specifically in the small village of Näsviken, we’ve grown rapidly in recent years, transforming from a smaller national company into an international group. Today, we operate in Sweden, the Netherlands, and Denmark.Our goal is straightforward: to make life a little easier for entrepreneurs and business owners. We believe we can do that through great software, knowledge, innovation, and TACO. Not the kind you might be thinking of - but our version: Trust, Ambition, Collaboration, and Ownership.What We OfferWe offer you a role in an international, growing company with a strong market position and the ambition to challenge industry giants. The wellbeing of our employees truly matters to us, and we want to be a fair and responsible employer where people feel good and enjoy their work.We strive for a healthy work-life balance and support this through competitive conditions and benefits and flexible work opportunities. We want to be the natural first choice for people who want to thrive and have fun at work.ApplicationThis is a full-time, permanent position based in Stockholm or Hudiksvall. Application deadline is 13th December 2026, but selection and interviews may take place on an ongoing basis. The position may therefore be filled before the deadline, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.For questions, feel free to contact: Johan Lindahl, Head of Product Management johan.lindahl@bjornlunden.com *For this recruitment, we kindly ask that recruitment agencies or other external partners refrain from contacting us.

jobs.occupation: Senior Enterprise Account Executive – New Logo Sales
jobs.description: Tacton is looking for a Senior Account Executive who loves the hunt. In this net-new logo role, you'll own a territory of named enterprise manufacturers across Europe, open doors at companies new to Tacton, and close deals that help them make every customer promise one their factory can keep. You'll lead multi-stakeholder sales cycles of 6–12+ months, from first outreach to signature, engaging executives across sales, engineering, operations, and IT. Sales Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Success, and Marketing will support you, but the pipeline, deal strategy, and close are yours. You'll report to our SVP EMEA in a performance-driven sales organization with clear goals and transparent metrics. What you'll do  Hunt for new logos: Build pipeline across named target accounts together with your Business Development Manager  Open executive doors: Build trusted relationships with the C-suite, economic buyers, and champions across business and IT  Lead discovery and value mapping: Uncover challenges, quantify impact, and build the business case using the Tacton Sales Process  Run complex deal cycles: Keep multi-threaded opportunities moving and stakeholders aligned  Quarterback the team: Bring in Sales Engineering, Professional Services, and leadership at the right moments  Stay close to your market: Keep a steady cadence of calls, meetings, site visits, demos, and events  Negotiate and close: Lead commercial and legal negotiations to signature  Exceed your number: Consistently exceed your new-business quota Requirements  7+ years of enterprise software sales, with a proven record of winning new logos across multiple multi-year tenures  Consistent quota attainment, closing six- and seven-figure deals  Experience selling mission-critical enterprise systems (e.g., ERP, PLM, CRM, supply chain, or industrial software). Manufacturing experience is a strong plus; CPQ is a plus, not a requirement  Experience selling to executive buying committees  Daily hands-on use of AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) to research prospects, prepare for meetings, and manage your pipeline  Experience from fast-growth, private equity-backed companies is preferred  Fluent English; German, French, or a Scandinavian language is a strong plus Who you are  A hunter at heart: Prospecting isn't a chore, it's how you win  Resilient: You hear "no" and keep going  A proven closer: You create urgency, navigate procurement, and get deals signed  Driven by the numbers: You own your metrics and see KPIs as tools to win  A value storyteller: You sell business outcomes, not features, to CFOs and VPs of Engineering alike  In it for the long game: You build pipeline that pays off in year two and beyond, and you've done it more than once  Present with customers: You build trust in person through site visits, workshops, and plant tours  A coachable team player: You take direction, share what works, and win with your team  Transparent: You believe in honesty and openness Recruitment process 1. Screening call with Talent Acquisition 2. Interview with the hiring manager 3. Personality and logical ability test 4. Second interview and peer meeting, including a case study or value pitch 5. Interview with senior management 6. Reference and background checks Why Tacton? Grow your career in a global, open organization that values teamwork and uses the latest technology to solve complex challenges in manufacturing.  33 days of paid time off (30 vacation days + 3 extra)  Premium occupational pension beyond ITP1  5,000 SEK annual wellness allowance  Private healthcare insurance  Parental leave top-up to 90% of base salary for up to 6 months  Weekly fika or breakfast * Hybrid setup: 3 days a week in the office Promise what you can build. Build what you promised. For 26 years, Tacton has helped manufacturers of complex products do exactly that. Through Tacton's Connected Suite, every configuration flows on one digital thread from product definition to the factory floor, and AI agents can promise only what can actually be built. Learn more at www.tacton.com

jobs.description: Do you want to lead procurement for the construction of the largest solar and battery storage projects in the Nordics? We are looking for a skilled procurement professional with a strong commercial foundation and the curiosity to understand technical solutions in depth. You are willing to dig into specifications, ask questions and work closely with engineers and suppliers to make well-informed purchasing decisions in a rapidly evolving industry. Join us and be part of an ambitious team building the energy infrastructure of tomorrow.What will you do at NYAB? As our Technical Procurement Manager, you will work at the intersection of long-term sourcing strategy and practical project delivery, leading procurement for utility-scale solar and battery energy storage system (BESS) projects. Your scope will include core components and services such as solar modules, inverters, mounting systems, transformers, batteries, subcontractors and related technical solutions. In this role, you will:     Own and develop the end-to-end procurement lifecycle, from early tendering and supplier evaluation to contracting and execution.     Lead strategic and commercial negotiations to secure competitive terms, balanced risk positions and strong contractual outcomes.     Evaluate supplier offers against technical requirements, cost, quality and delivery needs, working with engineering colleagues to clarify specifications and understand trade-offs.    Stay ahead of the market by identifying new technologies, suppliers and system solutions that strengthen our renewable energy projects and make our supply chain more resilient    Drive procurement priorities against project requirements, schedules and budgets – and make sure we deliver. You will act as our internal product owner, digging into specifications, drawings and technical documentation together with the engineering team until you know the product as well as the supplier does. About you You are a goal-oriented self-starter with the persistence to follow through and make things happen. You combine sound commercial judgment with technical curiosity and a willingness to work through details, ask questions and understand what you are buying. You remain composed during complex contractual discussions and take ownership of your commitments, combining speed with precision and going the extra mile when it matters. Along the way, you build trust with colleagues, suppliers and partners.We believe you have:     A master’s degree in engineering, preferably within electrical engineering, mechanical engineering or energy systems.     At least three years of hands-on experience in large-scale procurement projects with complex technical scopes, ideally in an EPC environment.     Experience in end-to-end sourcing, supplier management and commercial or contractual negotiations.     Strong cost awareness and the ability to manage priorities within time and budget constraints.     Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.     The willingness to travel internationally to meet suppliers and partners, and to visit project sites in Sweden and abroad. It is an advantage if you have:     Experience in construction, electrical systems, renewable energy or another technically complex project environment.     Experience procuring equipment or services for solar parks, BESS or related energy infrastructure.     Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Swedish.Why work at NYAB? NYAB's greatest strength is our drive and the pride we take in our work. We all pull in the same direction – forward. We value people for their competence and initiative, and you get the freedom to act along with the accountability that comes with it. Our entrepreneurial spirit is built on collaboration and commitment. We are a close-knit community where colleagues support one another, share knowledge and work together to find solutions when new challenges arise. You will never work alone – you will have the support of colleagues and leaders, and plenty of room to grow. We also offer:    Comprehensive health assessments     Generous wellness allowance     Parental pay supplement    Reduced working hours – (Sw: arbetstidsförkortning)    A secure pension planReady to make it happen? Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile. We review applications on an ongoing basis and look forward to hearing from you. Start: As agreed   Employment type: Full-time   Location: Hägersten, Stockholm

jobs.description: Company DescriptionAs Trade & Customs Operations Manager, you will lead and develop Trade & Customs operations across the Logistics Continent, ensuring our cross-border flows are efficient, compliant and built for future growth. You will set priorities for continent Trade operations and work closely with local Trade & Customs teams and Global Trade. The role combines strategic leadership with operational responsibility, covering import and export flows, performance, compliance, cost, risk and continuous improvement. jobs.description: Stockholm outside, a world of guests inside, and a kitchen ready for your ideas. It´s time to bring your flavour to Sheraton Stockholm.  Sheraton Stockholm has been bringing people together in the heart of the city since 1971. Today, we’re shaping our next chapter, with a major transformation, fresh energy and new places to eat, drink and connect. With Archer Hotel Management as our operator and Marriott International as our brand family, we combine an international outlook with a strong sense of place. Now we’re looking for a Head Chef to lead the food experience at Mr. Bronck, Sally’s and our room service operation. Someone with a clear culinary point of view, a head for business and the ability to build a team people want to be part of.  From dinner at Mr. Bronck to food that complements a cocktail at Sally’s or a great meal delivered upstairs, you’ll make sure every experience feels considered, consistent and right for the setting. You’ll lead the daily a la carte kitchen operation and develop seasonal menus that give each concept its own character. Taste, presentation and timing matter equally, and you know how to deliver all three when service picks up. Behind every great service is a well-run kitchen You’ll take ownership of menu costing, purchasing, stock control and staffing, keeping quality high and food waste low. You’ll turn business forecasts into smart schedules, maintain strong food safety and HACCP routines, and keep a close eye on the financial performance of the operation. Just as importantly, you’ll recruit, coach and develop your team. You set clear expectations, share your knowledge and stay approachable under pressure. Working closely with colleagues across the hotel, you’ll help create a seamless experience for our guests. A creative chef and a grounded leaderYou bring at least five years of experience in a similar leadership role in a quality restaurant or hotel kitchen. You’re confident developing menus, leading busy services and balancing culinary ambition with commercial results. You care about the details and understand how your decisions affect the whole operation. You bring structure, curiosity and high professional standards, and you enjoy finding practical solutions when plans change. Your team can count on you for direction, support and a steady presence during a demanding service. You communicate confidently in English; Swedish is a plus. An established network within the industry is also welcome. You’ll join an international, inclusive workplace with opportunities to grow within Sheraton and the wider Marriott family, alongside access to employee hotel rates around the world.
